about: The daily-surface recon seed (docs/internal/betterment/daily/RECON.md): three meetings of one week, Mira, Theo and Jun. The transcripts and the summary results are written here from the recon's shots and friction log; the recon's own LLM replies were not kept. Dates are the recon's week: the fixture's Monday is 2026-10-19 (the morning of the job).

meetings.title: Payments platform sync
segments: Let's go through the ledger cutover. We freeze ledger writes during the cutover window.
I'll draft the rollback runbook by Tuesday.
I can profile the reconciliation job, Friday next week at the latest.
I'll confirm the vendor freeze dates this week.
And I'll email Dana about the cutover window on Monday.
meetings.summary: The team agreed to freeze ledger writes during the cutover. Mira drafts the rollback runbook; Theo profiles the reconciliation job; Jun confirms the vendor freeze dates.

actions.task: Email Dana about the cutover window

decisions.decision: Freeze ledger writes during the cutover
decisions.rationale: A write during the cutover cannot be reconciled.

meetings.title: 1:1 with Theo
segments: I wrote the design doc on settlement retries. Can you review it?
I'll review your design doc by Monday.
I'll write up the alert rule changes by Thursday.
Let's talk about the staff path in our next one-on-one.
meetings.summary: Theo asked for a review of his design doc on settlement retries and will write up the alert rule changes.

actions.task: Review design doc on settlement retries

decisions.decision: Talk about the staff path in our next one-on-one

meetings.title: Architecture review
segments: The question is how we retry settlement calls safely.
Idempotent retries with a dedupe key. The doc has the details.
Agreed, we adopt idempotent retries with a dedupe key.
I'll load-test the dedupe key path. Friday next week.
meetings.summary: The review adopted idempotent retries with a dedupe key; Jun load-tests the dedupe key path.

decisions.decision: Adopt idempotent retries with a dedupe key
decisions.rationale: A retried settlement call must not pay twice.

kept.about: The recon's nine Confirm presses: every action and the two real decisions. 'Do it' and the staff-path row stay to decide.
unkept_decisions: Talk about the staff path in our next one-on-one
